title: Sinatra conducting a Peggy Lee record
summary: He recalls recording with Peggy Lee under Sinatra's baton and no longer has the album.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Recordings, yes. And with Sinatra, naturally, and we flew about four months we did those concerts on Saturdays and Sundays, so I worked with him and recorded with different people. And I can't remember this woman -- she's a very good singer.
Peggy Lee! Yeah, that's the one where Sinatra conducted.
Does he have credit on it? Does he have conductor credit on the album?
Well, I don't know about that.
Yeah, he was the conductor on that particular piece.

Oh, that's very interesting. Do you remember what album that is? The name of the album, or some of the tunes on it? Because I'd like to know to check it out and see, because that is something I haven't heard before.
I had the album and I don't know if I still got it; I don't believe so, because I used to give my records out, you know?
I've got some records in there that I used to give away, you know?
Do you have copies of everything that you've done?
